name: desktop
description_en: Free and open source streaming software built on OBS and Electron.
readme_excerpt: Streamlabs Desktop Simple, powerful, and efficient live streaming software built on Electron and OBS. This application currently only supports OSX 10.14+ and 64-bit Windows. Dependencies Node.js Node is required for installing npm packages and for running various scripts. We recommend the latest LTS release. https://nodejs.org Yarn We use Yarn as our package manager.
